reasons: Selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge" but postgresql.tup_updated is a monotonic sum in the dataset (dataset_types: sum); the matcher should be otel_metric_type="sum".
Template variable $db (tag prefix db) is not turned into a matcher. It should filter on the observed label postgresql_database_name, since db_namespace is absent in the dataset.
Template variable $host (tag prefix host) is not turned into a matcher. It should filter on host_name=~"$host", which is observed in the dataset.
$scope has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct; $table is not used by the query.

Aggregation differs: the candidate averages rate() values, while the Datadog query averages the raw metric per db. Applying rate() also changes the quantity to a per-second rate unless the Datadog series is already a rate; the source does not show this.
Grouping by postgresql_database_name matches the Datadog by {db} grouping and uses the observed label name.
Outcome translated is appropriate, since an OTel counterpart measuring rows updated exists in the dataset.
